author: wfahle
description: Konnected Garage Door Opener (GDO White) addon for WebThings Gateway
name: Konnected GDO White

schema.description: Configuration for the Konnected GDO White adapter

log_level.description: Log level. Use WARNING as standard

discover.description: Automatically discover GDO devices on the local network using mDNS (_konnected._tcp)

poll_interval.description: Seconds between REST health polls. Live updates arrive over the device's event stream; this is only a fallback.

devices.title: Manually configured devices
devices.description: GDO devices to add by address. Not needed when discovery finds the device.

host.description: IP address or hostname of the device (e.g. 192.168.1.50 or konnected-abc123.local)

port.description: HTTP port of the device web server (default 80)

name.description: Optional title for the Thing (default: Garage Door <device id>)
